header.title: Every call made to the Delphi Frontier MCP by the DELPHI contribution pass
header.transport: JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP, one POST per request at that exact path
header.credential_policy: The bearer was passed ONLY as an inline Authorization request header, set from an environment variable assigned on the same command line. It is not in this log, not in any script, not in any committed file, and was never echoed. It was sent only on the 23 authenticated calls listed below (1 manifest read + 22 successful proposes + 2 refused proposes = 25 authenticated requests in total); every other call was an anonymous public read needing no credential.
header.identity: actor team-demo-agent, operator local-fleet, roles [contributor], namespaces [delphi-frontier], daily_write_limit 1000. SHARED team identity: everything written is attributed to the whole team, not to DELPHI or to the authoring thread.
header.timestamp_note: The ten prelude calls and the four postlude calls were made by hand with curl before and after the logging script existed; their UTC times are accurate to the minute and their durations are the observed curl timings, rounded. Calls 11 to 56 were logged programmatically at second precision.

calls.note: MANDATORY FIRST CALL, anonymous. Manifest frontier-mcp-capabilities-0.2, record schema frontier-record-0.1, mode write_enabled, principal null when anonymous, 18 tools, 11 record kinds, limits max_record_bytes 65536 / search_page_max 50, and the not_available list.

calls.note: OPERATOR ERROR, logged for completeness. A bearer header was intended but the shell expanded the variable before the inline assignment took effect, so an EMPTY bearer was sent. The server refused rather than falling back to anonymous, exactly as its manifest says it would. No credential was transmitted on this call.

calls.note: Assessment payload schema read and DELIBERATELY NOT USED. We hold the contributor role only, and an Assessment is a review act; the manifest states review/accept/dispute happens at HTTP POST /v1/reviews with a reviewer's own credential and is unavailable over MCP.

calls.note: Problem payload schema. Required: title, known_state, question, problem_kind, novelty_status, data_access, required_capabilities, downstream_uses, source. Its own description documents that an 'actionable' Problem must carry acceptance_criteria, falsifiers, next_action and cost_stop_bounds while a 'recorded' one may omit all four. dependencies[] takes Refs, which is how a cross-namespace link is made.
